title: The Incredible Benefits of Eyelid Surgery

html:
While no one likes to admit that they judge others based on their outer appearance, it is something that we all do. Just think of how you view someone who looks as if they are extremely tired or stressed out. You may feel sorry for the individual. You may wonder what is going on in their life that is making them feel and look so worn out.

Fortunately, individuals who have a lot of baggy skin on top of and/or under their eyes may be able to gain incredible benefits with eyelid surgery, or blepharoplasty. After a person goes through eyelid surgery, they come out looking refreshed, more youthful and more confident. They look like they are ready to take on the world instead of crawl back into their bed and sleep their life away.

One of the biggest benefits of eyelid surgery is the fact that you look more alert and happier. When there is a lot of skin hanging over your eyes, it makes you look like you just cannot handle anything else in life. However, this may not be the case at all. You may be ready for more responsibility and be ready to take on new things in life. However, your outer appearance is saying something completely different.

The great thing about eyelid surgery is that it is not going to take you months to recover. Once you have fully healed, you’re going to reap great benefits, but you will not have noticeable scarring on your face that makes it obvious that you had a surgical procedure done in order to improve your appearance.

Some individuals only need to have surgery performed on their lower or upper eyelid in order to get the best results. Other individuals combine the two surgeries in order to treat saggy skin on their upper and lower eyelid if it is needed.

When you come in for a consultation at Hanemann Plastic Surgery, we are going to closely examine your eyes and then help you make a decision that will improve your appearance and make you look refreshed. If it is determined that eyelid surgery is right for you, Dr. Hanemann can walk you through the procedure and come up with a customized surgery that is completely tailored around your wants and needs.

Hanemann Plastic Surgery is located in Baton Rouge, LA. Contact us today to schedule a consultation for eyelid surgery.
